method.method_draft: Forward-state enumeration. First read the diagrams: machine R rotates the square 90° clockwise, shown by the black corner moving from lower-left to upper-left; machine S leaves the black corner in place and adds a club-shaped print; the target row has four machine slots and ends with one club and the black corner at lower-right. From the text and diagrams, S is the only operation that prints, so since the target has exactly one club, exactly one of the four slots is S and the other three are R. Three R operations move the black corner from lower-left to lower-right, matching the target regardless of where the single S is placed. To locate S, compare the club in the S-output diagram with the target club: the target club is the S print after two further 90° clockwise rotations. Therefore S must be followed by exactly two R operations. With four operations total and three R's, the only order is RSRR.
